task: Independently identify the strongest defensible repository stacks for each functional layer and their strongest challengers. Establish useful distinctions, not a universal best ranking.
constraints: Primary setup target is Linux/WSL2 x86_64; destination hardware and sign-ins are not yet accepted.
Preserve existing native Codex and Claude account/configuration boundaries. Other SDKs/runtimes may qualify when their function warrants them.
Local CPU-first setup; GPU, containers and paid hosting are conditional on actual requirements, cost and acceptance, not categorically excluded.
The long-term application is US-equity research and historical simulation followed by separately qualified IBKR/Alpaca paper operation; this review executes no orders.
Compare repository engineering quality and workload fit. Popularity, recency, vendor claims and model agreement alone do not establish a winner.
withheld: Existing repository catalog, selected dispositions, prior reviewer conclusions, installed-version preferences and star counts.
allowed_evidence: Current primary upstream documentation, pinned source, upstream tests and maintained examples.
Public discovery lists may discover candidates but do not prove their merit.
Local execution is untested unless you actually execute and retain a scoped result; do not run installations for this discovery task.
criteria: upstream tests and independent measured evidence
maintenance, identifiable source and dependency compatibility
installation, scope, restart, export/restore, deletion and portability
complete measured quality, latency and cost; unknown is an allowed result

layers.requirement: Run coding and bounded research with existing native accounts, client tools, chosen models and resumable sessions.
Supply concise task rules and reusable upstream procedures across coding clients; qualify discovery, invocation and conflicting guidance.
Delegate independent work with owned edits, explicit effects, cancellation, returned results, failures and reviewable integration.
Enforce required filesystem/network restrictions and separate concurrent edits without conflating worktree ownership with sandboxing.
Find exact source, symbols and references across the needed languages, with verified originals and measured indexing overhead.
Ingest and retrieve attributable Markdown and document content, preserving originals, structured data and scope.
Answer conceptual code questions using scoped search and a compatible embedding service with recoverable indexing state.
Keep scoped decisions, handoffs and learning available across coding clients with inspectable capture, deletion and restoration.
Acquire attributable primary sources and perform reproducible browser/research tasks with bounded access, complete outputs and measurable operating cost.
Supply useful task context with recoverable originals; distinguish representation size, provider usage, latency and answer quality.
Verify changed software and AI behavior with relevant upstream/project tests, independent observations and retained negative results.
Publish reproducible software with scoped workflow permissions, identifiable dependencies, runtime inventory and attributable checks.
Schedule and supervise local or distributed jobs with visible history, bounded process trees, cancellation and recoverable effects.
Reproduce typed application interfaces and supporting services on local WSL, with explicit ownership of state, accounts and deployment costs.
Reproduce selected tools and restore application state on another PC without copying authentication stores or transferring old acceptance.
Inspect actual task, service and inference outcomes with scoped telemetry, privacy controls and workload-qualified model serving.
Retrieve dated financial/document knowledge and exact code across clients, with source recovery, isolation and measurable retrieval quality.
Run and supervise bounded equity research with complete returned results and failures, scoped telemetry and recoverable state. Research workers cannot execute broker actions.
Acquire appropriately licensed US-equity observations with identity, timestamps, feed semantics, corporate actions and point-in-time eligibility preserved.
Reproduce US-equity historical simulation and broker-specific paper workflows with deterministic numeric risk, accounting, causal data, costs and independent reconciliation.

for_each_layer: primary_stack (repository URLs, multiple complementary tools allowed)
disclosure: Was any current catalog/ranking/other review seen?
Which layers remain weakly researched or depend on prior model knowledge?
Observed model/effort if exposed, sources, failed fetches and unknown usage.
return_contract.limits: Do not force a unique winner for complementary tools or settle unknown comparisons by voting. Freeze your complete report before receiving other reviews.
